 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest this week is Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of leading game publisher, Take-Two Interactive, maybe most well-known for its hugely successful Grand Theft Auto game. Take-Two is a sophisticated top-tier developer, publisher and marketer of interactive entertainment that owns Rockstar Games and 2K. Strauss' passion for entertainment led him strong and fast into the industry as he worked his way from sales to CEO and transitioned from motion pictures to gaming.

 Today, we cover his approach to staying on the cutting edge of media development, unlocking talent and potential in those around you and becoming the leader you are meant to be. His intensity and his standard for excellence comes through clearly. Please enjoy my conversation with Strauss Zelnick.

 A Lifelong Journey Through Media
